name: Swedish Massage
description: A gentle, relaxing massage that uses long strokes, kneading, deep circular movements, vibration, and tapping to help you feel energized.

name: Deep Tissue Massage
description: Focuses on realigning deeper layers of muscles and connective tissue. It is especially helpful for chronically tense and contracted areas.

name: Hot Stone Massage
description: Heated, smooth stones are placed on specific points on your body to warm and relax muscles, allowing for deeper pressure during the massage.

name: Aromatherapy Massage
description: Uses essential oils to enhance the therapeutic benefits of massage. Each oil has unique properties to relax, energize, or uplift.

name: Reflexology
description: A type of massage that involves applying different amounts of pressure to the feet, hands, and ears.

name: Shiatsu Massage
description: A form of Japanese bodywork based on concepts in traditional Chinese medicine such as the use of chi meridians.

name: Thai Massage
description: Combines acupressure, Indian Ayurvedic principles, and assisted yoga postures.

name: Sports Massage
description: Designed to help athletes prepare their bodies for optimal performance, recover after a big event, or function well during training.

name: Prenatal Massage
description: A gentle massage that focuses on the special needs of the mother-to-be as her body goes through the dramatic changes of pregnancy.

name: Couples Massage
description: A massage for two people, typically in the same room, with two therapists.

name: Chair Massage
description: A short massage, usually lasting 10 to 30 minutes, that focuses on your back, shoulders, and neck.

name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage
description: A gentle massage that encourages the movement of lymph fluids around the body.
